response.original_title: ((Step-by-Step-Guide)) How to File a Charge Dispute with MSC Cruises?
response.overview: To file a dispute or billing complaint with MSC Cruises, contact their Guest Experience or Customer Relations team by calling +1-866-829-1280 or emailing GuestExperience@MSC.com. Collect your booking reference number, sailing date, ship name, itemized onboard statements, and any supporting receipts or emails. Call MSC +1-866-829-1280 or email them with a clear subject line stating it is a formal billing complaint or dispute.
